sections.h2: Picking up your car at Gatwick
sections.html: Gatwick has two terminals, North and South, linked by a free shuttle train. Several big brands have rental desks in the terminals, with cars parked close by, while some suppliers operate off-airport with a shuttle bus. Your voucher tells you which terminal and meeting point to use, so check it matches your flight.

Gatwick connects directly to the M23, which links to the M25 for the rest of the UK and runs south towards Brighton. It’s a good base for the South Downs, the Sussex and Kent coast and the Surrey Hills. The UK drives on the left.

faqs.q: Is car hire at Gatwick North or South Terminal?
faqs.a: It depends on the company. Some have desks in both terminals, others in one, and some are off-airport. Your booking confirmation says where to go.
